criteria.description: Every required object, group, label, symbol, and connector visible in the reference is present in the candidate; no required element is omitted.
Matched elements have the same relative and normalized positions as in the reference.
Matched shapes preserve relative size and aspect ratio.
Containment and overlap relationships match the reference and introduce no unintended collisions.
All required lines and arrows are present; no required connection is missing.
Each connector attaches to the correct source and destination, with the correct direction.
All text content, numbers, punctuation, and capitalization match the reference.
Colors, fills, strokes, line styles, and arrowhead styles match the reference.
Shape types and small visual marks match the reference.
Text stays inside its intended container without clipping, collision, or overflow.
Every text element meets the configured minimum rendered font size.
